final: SELECT u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(*) AS averaged_over, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) - (SELECT AVG(scope_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(f2.feerate - f2.rebrate) AS scope_avg FROM fees f2 JOIN orders o2 ON f2.orderslink = o2.recordvault JOIN users u2 ON o2.userlink = u2.userstamp GROUP BY u2.acctscope)) AS distance_from_simple_mean FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope
